name: Confounding Flash
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Just a short time ago, one of your priests was here looking for you, friend. He said that if I were to see you, I should direct you towards the Hall of Mysteries. He said it was very important, but I would not be overly concerned if I were you. His demeanor seemed positive... as though it were good news. I wouldn't take too long in making my way there if I were you.

Elune be with you, good friend.
narrative.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
